COST: 212

Assumptions behind this plan:
- The injured are counted separately from the other descriptions, so Gosaikunda has 4 injured, 2 adults and 3 children, Kakani has 3 injured and 1 child, Jwalamukhi has 3 injured and 2 children, and Naukunda has 3 adults.
- Pupils and the schoolgirl are children, and labourers and shopkeepers are adults.
- Roads can be driven in either direction.
- Jwalamukhi school is used only as a pass-through point for pickups, never as a drop-off.

The plan rescues 20 people and defers one adult at Gosaikunda. Driving totals 192 minutes and the deferral adds 20. Deferring the single adult saves a third Gosaikunda trip (46 minutes) for a penalty of 20.
